user_reported_bug: data is wiped but public id is missing again
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Backend-only verification against the preview API confirmed the missing-public_id symptom is fixed for the super admin and for a staff user missing public_id after POST /api/admin/system/wipe-demo-data. Regression checks also confirmed password/confirm guardrails, demo collection wipe markers, legal_documents/settings preservation, and super-admin-only counter.seq=1. However the full public_id/counter acceptance is not fixed: when a preserved staff user already has PL10001, the wipe resets counter.seq to 1, and the next signup received duplicate public_id PL10001 instead of PL10002.

critical.issue: Counter reset is too low when non-super staff already have existing public_ids. Runtime proof: after preserving super admin PL10000 plus operator PL10001, wipe left counters.user_public_id.seq=1; the next /api/auth/register call succeeded with public_id PL10001, duplicating the preserved staff user's public_id. Expected next signup was PL10002 because two staff users were preserved.

action_items: Update wipe_demo_data counter reset to account for all preserved staff public_ids, not only staff missing public_id; after super admin + one preserved staff PL10001, counters.user_public_id.seq should be 2 so the next signup gets PL10002.
Add a self-test for the idempotent case: super_admin=PL10000 and staff=PL10001 before wipe, then assert counter.seq=2 and a subsequent signup does not duplicate PL10001.
Consider preventing duplicate assignment when some staff already have PL10001 and another staff user is missing public_id.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/admin_routes.py lines 604-620 initialize next_num to 10001 and only increment it while assigning missing non-super staff IDs. Existing staff with public_id PL10001 are excluded from that loop, so next_num remains 10001 and seq is reset to 1 even though PL10001 is already in use.

/app/backend/routers/admin_routes.py lines 605-613 also do not skip already-used public_id values while assigning missing staff; a mixed case with one existing PL10001 and another missing staff public_id could assign PL10001 again.
seed_data_creation: Created QA-only super-admin public_id mutation, one missing-public_id admin, one existing PL10001 operator, one regular demo user, wallets, sentinels in legal_documents/settings, and one marker row in every wipeable collection (contests, orders, tickets, winner_audit, admin_audit, support_cases, game_scores, leaderboard_entries, instant-win collections, etc.). Final cleanup removed QA users/markers/audit rows and left super admin public_id=PL10000 with counters.user_public_id.seq=1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview API tested: https://contest-arena-16.preview.emergentagent.com against DB_NAME=test_database. Super admin credentials worked. Passing evidence: missing super_admin public_id was backfilled to PL10000; missing admin staff public_id was backfilled to PL10001; seeded wipeable collection markers were removed; wrong confirm returned 400; wrong password returned 401; legal_documents/settings were preserved; final super-admin-only wipe left counter.seq=1. Failing evidence: idempotent existing staff PL10001 retained its ID, but counter.seq became 1 and next signup received duplicate PL10001 instead of PL10002. No APIs were MOCKED.
rca_of_the_issue: The wipe endpoint's backfill block computes next_num only from newly assigned missing staff IDs. If staff already have public_ids, those IDs are retained but not counted when resetting counters.user_public_id.seq. Repro: seed super_admin PL10000 and operator PL10001, call POST /api/admin/system/wipe-demo-data with correct password and confirm, inspect counters.user_public_id.seq=1, then register a new user and observe public_id PL10001 duplicate.
